reason: Router.Dispatch (internal/tools/router.go:72) checks every call against the caller's role allowlist. At internal/investigator/investigator.go:70 the caller is the parent oncall run, whose allowlist includes rollback_release, so no tool outside a listed role is called. The flaw is that the parent runs a child's recommendation under its own role with PreApproved:true, which lets a child gain the parent's power and skip approval. That is E08 ('give sub-agents only the powers approved for their task'), and the key already scores this exact line under E08.
requirement_words: Enforce a role-based allowlist, and check that an unlisted tool can't be called.
